tasks.title: Conversation #7
tasks.transcript:
MEN: I can't believe this, but I managed to book a ticket to Singapore. I will be on the seven o'clock flight tomorrow morning.
WOMAN: That's great. Does that mean that you will get to see your friend who moved out there a few years back after you are finished meeting with Mr. Wang?
MEN: I am not sure because Mr. Wang will probably want to take me around the plant site on the day I arrive there. I am hoping that I will be able to see my friend the day after, but he mentioned that he might have to leave town that day. He said he would try to rearrange his trip, but I have not spoken to him for a few days. I will call him tonight to see if he is able to do that.
WOMAN: You should just take your vacation early and spend a week there after you take care of your business. It's not like you get to travel to the Far East all the time, you know.

questions.stem: What will the man do tomorrow?

options.A: Help his friend move into a new place.
options.B: Leave on an overseas business trip.
options.C: Take Mr. Wang to the factory site.
options.D: Prepare for his vacation to the Far East.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士明天要做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住男士对明天行程安排的具体描述。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中提到男士的朋友几年前搬到了新加坡，但并未说明男士要帮朋友搬家，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 男士明确说“I managed to book a ticket to Singapore. I will be on the seven o'clock flight tomorrow morning”，并且提到要与王先生会面、参观工厂等，说明他明天将出发去国外出差。 选项C：错误。 男士说王先生可能想带他参观工厂（Mr. Wang will probably want to take me around the plant site），而不是他带王先生去，属于主客颠倒。 选项D：错误。 女士建议男士提前休假并在处理完公事后待一周，但男士本人并未表示要为此做准备，且他明天的主要行程是出差而非准备度假。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do?

options.A: Go on the trip another time.
options.C: Talk to Mr. Wang right away.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士建议男士做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士在对话末尾提出的明确建议。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 女士并未建议男士改天再去，而是建议他办完公事后直接提前休假，在当地多待一周。 选项B：正确。 女士明确说“You should just take your vacation early and spend a week there after you take care of your business”，即建议他提前休假。 选项C：错误。 男士提到自己会今晚给朋友打电话，但女士并未建议他立即与王先生谈话，属于无关干扰。 选项D：错误。 男士已经订好了机票，女士没有建议他提前订票，属于与原文无关的干扰项。
